METHOD RULES (from the 15:27Z ruling — they decide every sentence you write):
- A new sentence may DISTIL evidenced content; it may NOT EXTEND it. Both read clean; only one is safe.
- Every newly-written rule carries its evidence in the doc's existing form (file:line, probe paths) or an explicit unverified mark — an evidence-less distilled sentence is indistinguishable from an invented one.

   - _viewer:<entity-id> accepted-but-inert (distils §6 lines 131/133);
   - both-directions replacement / create-then-grant-lower demotes (distils §7.3 + §7.2's practical consequence; if the demote direction lacks an explicit evidenced sentence in-doc, check the probe ledgers cited in §7.2/§7.3 before marking unverified).

A clean general rule on one narrow probe is FORBIDDEN; it would be this epic's own first output failing its own purpose. Default: include, scoped.

(9) Any CONTRADICTION between doc and evidence discovered while distilling: STOP that item, report as substantive-correction candidate (own issue per #316) — never silently fix.

tasks.commitBody: Every rule in the rights model document now carries a stable identifier — the handle a claim cites instead of paraphrasing, which is the failure this epic exists to stop. Identifiers are non-positional and permanent: assigned once in creation order, never reused, never renumbered; the § numbers stay as navigation and every existing external §-citation resolves untouched. Where the document already had an operative sentence, the identifier anchors that sentence unchanged; where the commissioned inventory named a rule never stated as one citable sentence, a new distilled statement carries the identifier — distilling, never extending, each with its evidence in the document's own citation form, because a distilled sentence with no evidence line is indistinguishable from an invented one. Qualifications are their own identified rules, cross-referenced from the rules they bound, never clauses — the per-reference qualifier died today precisely because it lived as a clause nobody had cause to repeat — and the claims whose whole point is what happens silently keep their silence stated, since a rule stated without its silence reads as complete and leaves the reader confident. The _parent gating asymmetry ships scoped to exactly what was probed under #304 — one property, one entity type, one date, probe and result paths attached — and states plainly that it is not established as general behaviour. The personal name in §7.3's provenance is gone, replaced by the investigation's description, per the privacy ruling on #318: the name carried no part of the mechanism and did not belong in a public architecture document. A vitest spec parses the document and enforces all of it mechanically — format, uniqueness, coverage, boundedness, cross-references, evidence markers, the superseded-keeps-its-identifier convention, and the name's absence — so the guard outlives this commit. The document now also says plainly that working notes carry identifiers, never restatements. STATED CHOICES: <GREEN agent fills>.
